# Vendor portal usability test protocol
## Consolidated screens: Orders, Share, Performance, Account and compliance

**Conducted by:** \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
**Participant:** \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
**Date:** \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
**Session length:** Allow 75 minutes

---

## Briefing (read aloud, do not improvise)

> Thank you for taking part. We are testing the software, not you -- there are
> no wrong answers. Please think aloud as you go: say what you are looking at,
> what you expect to happen, and anything that surprises you. I will not help
> you during a task, but I may ask questions afterwards. You can stop at any
> time.

Hand the participant a device with the vendor portal open on the home dashboard.
Do **not** point to any control or name any feature.

---

## Task set M -- Orders

Hand the participant a device with several pending orders and one catering enquiry
visible on the system. Do **not** explain the screen layout.

### M1

> "Find everything that is waiting for you to do something this week."

- **Target:** under 30 seconds, without leaving this screen
- **Pass:** participant identifies the pending standard order AND the catering
  enquiry, unaided, within 30 seconds, without navigating to another page
- **Failure modes to note:** participant navigates to a separate catering page
  (counts as a navigation -- note it); participant misses one category and
  declares done after finding only standard orders; participant cannot read the
  screen layout within 30 seconds and asks for guidance

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Number of page navigations (target: 0) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

---

### M2

> "Look at only your catering enquiries. Then look at only your standard orders.
> Then go back to seeing everything."

- **Target:** complete, unaided, within 60 seconds
- **Pass:** participant switches between all three views (catering only, standard
  only, all) and can describe the count change when switching, within 60 seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant cannot find the filter; participant
  confuses the filter with the tab (status row); participant does not notice that
  the counts change when filtering

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Described the count change when filtering (yes / no) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

---

### M3

> "A customer has asked you to cater their event. Send them a quote from this
> screen."

- **Target:** complete, unaided, within 2 minutes, without leaving the Orders screen
- **Pass:** participant locates the catering enquiry, opens the quote form or
  inline panel, enters an amount, and submits, within 2 minutes, zero
  navigations away from /orders
- **Failure modes to note:** participant navigates away to a separate catering
  page (that route now redirects -- note the reaction to the redirect);
  participant cannot find the quote action on the card; participant closes the
  modal without submitting

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Number of page navigations (target: 0) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

## Task set S -- Share and customers

### S1

> "Copy the link you would send to a new customer so they order from you directly."

- **Target:** under 30 seconds
- **Pass:** participant copies the correct referral link (not the public profile
  URL), unaided, within 30 seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant copies the public profile URL instead
  of the referral link; participant copies the QR code URL; participant is
  unsure which of two links to use (this would indicate the divergent-link
  defect has returned)

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| URL copied (record verbatim if possible) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

---

### S2

> "Download a QR code to put on a flyer."

- **Target:** under 30 seconds
- **Pass:** participant downloads a QR file (PNG or SVG), unaided, within 30
  seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant cannot find the QR section; participant
  finds the QR image but does not know how to save it; participant saves the SVG
  when they needed PNG (or vice versa -- note which format they chose and why)

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Format chosen (PNG / SVG) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

---

### S3

> "A customer placed an order using your personal link. How much commission did
> Feastpot take on that order?"

- **Target:** participant reads the answer from the screen, within 20 seconds
- **Pass:** participant correctly says 0% commission (or "no commission") and
  can point to where they read it, within 20 seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant guesses rather than reading; participant
  names the marketplace rate (12% or 10%) instead; participant says they cannot
  find the information

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Answer given (verbatim) | |
| Correct (yes / no) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

## Task set PF -- Performance

### PF1

> "Find out what percentage Feastpot charges on orders from new customers who
> found you on the marketplace."

- **Target:** under 30 seconds
- **Pass:** participant correctly identifies 12% as the first-time marketplace
  commission rate, unaided, within 30 seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant reads the repeat rate (10%) instead;
  participant reads the vendor-referred rate (0%) instead; participant cannot
  find the rate schedule at all

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Answer given (verbatim) | |
| Correct (yes / no) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

---

### PF2

> "How much notice does Feastpot give before raising commission or fee rates?"

- **Target:** under 30 seconds
- **Pass:** participant reads "30 days" from the screen, unaided, within 30
  seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant guesses; participant finds the terms
  notice period (15 days) and confuses it with the fee-change notice; participant
  says they cannot find the information

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Answer given (verbatim) | |
| Correct (yes / no) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

---

### PF3

> "When do your customers tend to order from you during the day?"

- **Target:** under 45 seconds
- **Pass:** participant finds the hourly chart and can identify at least one
  peak period, unaided, within 45 seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant cannot find the hourly breakdown;
  participant mistakes the weekly chart for the hourly one; participant is
  confused about which timezone the hours refer to

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Peak period identified (describe) | |
| Asked about timezone (yes / no) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

## Task set A -- Account and compliance

### A1

> "Check whether your account is in good standing right now."

- **Target:** under 20 seconds
- **Pass:** participant finds the Standing section first (it renders at the top
  of the page), reads the current status, and can say whether there is an active
  issue, within 20 seconds
- **Failure modes to note:** participant scrolls past Standing to the Compliance
  section without reading it; participant navigates away to look for status
  information; participant is not sure what "good standing" means in context

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Correct status reported (yes / no) | |
| First section participant looked at | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

---

### A2

> "Upload a new logo for your business."

- **Target:** complete, unaided, within 2 minutes
- **Pass:** participant uploads a logo file and it renders on screen without a
  page reload, within 2 minutes
- **Failure modes to note:** participant cannot find the upload control;
  participant navigates to a different settings page; participant uploads
  successfully but expects a reload and declares the upload broken because the
  image appeared without one; participant sees an error and does not know how
  to respond to it

| Observation | Notes |
|---|---|
| Completed unaided (yes / no) | |
| Time (seconds) | |
| Image rendered without reload (yes / no) | |
| Hesitations (describe each) | |
| Verbatim comments | |
| Pass / Fail | |

## Comprehension questions (screen hidden)

After all tasks are complete, turn the screen away or close the lid. Ask these
questions without showing the interface. Record answers verbatim.

### QM1

> "If a customer asks you to cater an event, what does the system expect you to
> do first?"

**Expected (any form):** send a quote; the catering booking needs a quote before
the customer can pay. A participant who says "accept the order", "confirm it
directly", or "call them" without mentioning a quote does **not** pass.

| Answer (verbatim) | Pass / Fail |
|---|---|
| | |

---

### QS1

> "Why does Feastpot give you a personal link rather than just your public
> profile page?"

**Expected (any form):** the personal link tracks orders back to the vendor's
own marketing so commission is 0%; the public profile page does not give this
discount. A participant who says "they are the same thing" or "for analytics
only" does **not** pass.

| Answer (verbatim) | Pass / Fail |
|---|---|
| | |

---

### QPF1

> "If you get a repeat marketplace order and a first-time marketplace order on
> the same day, will they both cost you the same commission rate?"

**Expected (any form):** no -- repeat orders cost 10%, first-time orders cost
12%. A participant who says "yes, the same" or cannot name both rates does **not**
pass.

| Answer (verbatim) | Pass / Fail |
|---|---|
| | |

---

### QA1

> "If your account were suspended, where on the portal would you find out why?"

**Expected (any form):** Account and compliance; the Standing section at the top.
A participant who says "the dashboard" or "I would get an email" without naming
the portal location does **not** pass.

| Answer (verbatim) | Pass / Fail |
|---|---|
| | |
